what: Every PP audio: log line the game can write, what it means for sound, the real .ogg a renderer places, the gain the game played it at, and the title theme's beat. Built from data/audio.json, game/datafiles/sfx/sfx.json, the PP_AUDIO_* macros in pp_audio.gml and the title theme loop ledger; every number is measured or parsed, none is typed.

sources.what: a headless demo run: the theme, footsteps, blips, a menu, focus, loads
the MUSIC-EVERYWHERE tour: cue streams, rooms, fights
an older run: the theme duck and the fallback path for a pending cue
a build whose manifest lacks the car_engine_loop row: the one silent-effect line

honest_clocks: the capture harness's arrival stamp: tools/play_demo.py LogAudioWatch reads the log every 0.05 s and places each line at the second it was read; lines already in the file when the watch starts are at 0.0 (the theme streams at boot)
a scripted run's own step clock: the line is written in the step the game played the sound, so a step offset from the script bounds it to one 1/60 s step
clock.note: a log line carries no time of its own. A renderer that has no harness stamps must not invent spacing; it can only place the lines in their written order.

beat.note: bar 1 beat 1 is at 0.000 s because the loop starts at sample 0; a renderer that wants the theme on a beat grid places it at a multiple of the bar

title_theme.trim: the bus loops the whole stream from 0; the render ends at the loop end sample 3275997 (74.285646 s) and the file may carry a short fade tail past it
title_theme.duck_defect: the game asks for a 6 dB duck with a positive number and multiplies by 10^(db/20), so a real log reads 'ducked 6 dB, gain 1.40': the theme gets 6 dB louder. A reconstruction follows the printed gain because that is what the game played; the sign is a game defect, filed separately

events.regex: ^PP audio: no effect manifest at .*sfx\.json, every effect stays silent$
events.meaning: the effect manifest is missing, so every effect in the run is silent
events.why_unobserved: fires only when sfx/sfx.json is missing from the build; no run in the tree was built without it

events.regex: ^PP audio: data/audio\.json has no cues table, every music cue stays silent$
events.meaning: the music table is missing, so every cue in the run is silent
events.why_unobserved: fires only when audio.json has no cues table; every sampled build had one

events.regex: ^PP audio: focus lost, music paused.*every effect stopped$
events.meaning: the window lost focus: the music is paused and every effect is stopped

events.regex: ^PP audio: focus back, music resumed where it stopped$
events.meaning: focus is back: the music resumes from the paused position

events.regex: ^PP audio: title_theme handed to the fade, the cue takes the one music source$
events.meaning: a cue is starting: the theme fades out over the bus fade and the cue takes the slot

events.regex: ^PP audio: title_theme stopping over (\d+) steps$
events.meaning: the theme fades out over the printed number of steps and stops
events.why_unobserved: fires only when a stop arrives with no cue playing and a theme still live

events.regex: ^PP audio: music stopping over (\d+) steps$
events.meaning: the cue fades out over the printed number of steps and stops
events.why_unobserved: fires only when the music is stopped while a cue is playing; no sampled run stopped its music

events.regex: ^PP audio: title_theme streaming (\S+), instance -?\d+, gain (-?[0-9.]+)$
events.meaning: the title theme starts from the named stream at the printed gain, looped

events.regex: ^PP audio: title_theme ducked (-?[0-9.]+) dB in the state, no stream instance to turn down$
events.meaning: a duck level is recorded for the next theme start; nothing is playing to turn down
events.why_unobserved: fires only when a duck is asked for before the theme stream exists

events.regex: ^PP audio: title_theme ducked (-?[0-9.]+) dB, gain (-?[0-9.]+)$
events.meaning: the theme's gain changes to the printed number right now

events.regex: ^PP audio: title_theme back to full after (-?[0-9.]+) dB$
events.meaning: the theme's gain goes back to the bus music level

events.regex: ^PP audio: music cue (\S+) streaming (.+), instance -?\d+, priority (-?\d+), fade (\d+) steps$
events.meaning: a music cue starts from the named file at the bus music level, looped, fading in

events.regex: ^PP audio: music cue (\S+) has no OGG yet, falling back to (\S+)$
events.meaning: the asked cue has no file, so the bus asked for the fallback; the next start line is the sound
events.why_unobserved: fires only when a cue row has no file and names a fallback; every sampled run asked for landed cues

events.regex: ^PP audio: music cue (\S+) has no OGG yet, expected (\S+), placeholder (\w+)$
events.meaning: the cue has no file where the game looks: silence, and the game plays no music here

events.regex: ^PP audio: music cue (\S+) silent, audio_create_stream failed on (.+)$
events.meaning: the file is there and the stream would not open: silence
events.why_unobserved: fires only when a file exists and audio_create_stream refuses it

events.regex: ^PP audio: music cue (\S+) silent, no audio channel for it$
events.meaning: no audio channel was free at the music priority: silence
events.why_unobserved: fires only when all ten channels are taken at the music priority

events.regex: ^PP audio: unknown music cue (\S+), nothing played$
events.meaning: a cue id the table does not know: silence
events.why_unobserved: fires only when the room or fight names a cue id the table does not hold

events.regex: ^PP audio: sfx (\S+) silent, not in sfx/sfx\.json$
events.meaning: the effect is not in the manifest: silence
events.why_unobserved: fires only on the pp_audio_sfx path with an id the manifest lacks; sampled misses all came through pp_audio_play

events.regex: ^PP audio: (\S+) loaded (\S+) \(([0-9.]+) s, (\d+) Hz, buffer (.+)\)$
events.meaning: the effect file was read into a buffer: no sound yet, the play line is the sound

events.regex: ^PP audio: (\S+) silent, no file at (.+)$
events.meaning: the effect file is missing: silence
events.why_unobserved: fires only when a manifest row names a wav that is not in the build

events.regex: ^PP audio: (\S+) silent, buffer_load failed on (.+)$
events.meaning: the effect file would not load: silence
events.why_unobserved: fires only when the wav is there and buffer_load refuses it

events.regex: ^PP audio: (\S+) silent, the measured length does not fit (.+)$
events.meaning: the manifest's measured length does not fit the file: silence
events.why_unobserved: fires only when the manifest's measured length does not fit the wav

events.regex: ^PP audio: (\S+) silent, audio_create_buffer_sound failed on (.+)$
events.meaning: the buffer sound would not be created: silence
events.why_unobserved: fires only when audio_create_buffer_sound refuses the buffer

events.regex: ^PP audio: ([a-z0-9_]+) played, instance -?\d+$
events.meaning: one effect plays once, at the level of the bus path that asked for it

events.regex: ^PP audio: (\S+) silent, not in sfx/sfx\.json$
events.meaning: an effect the cue list knows but the manifest does not ship: silence

events.regex: ^PP audio: unknown cue (\S+)$
events.meaning: a name that is not an effect at all: silence

events.regex: ^PP audio: room (\S+) names no music cue, the music in hand keeps playing$
events.meaning: the room names no cue: whatever music is playing keeps playing
events.why_unobserved: fires only when a map names no music cue; every sampled room names one

events.regex: ^PP audio: room (\S+) asked (\S+), playing (\S+) \((started|kept)\), stream (yes|no)$
events.meaning: the room asked for a cue; the start line above or below is the sound, this line is the verdict

events.regex: ^PP audio: fight (\S+) asked (\S+), playing (\S+) \((started|kept)\), stream (yes|no)$
events.meaning: the fight asked for a cue; the start line is the sound, this line is the verdict

events.regex: ^PP audio: no title theme stream in (.+)$
events.meaning: no theme stream file was found at boot: silence where the theme would be
events.why_unobserved: fires only when no theme stream file is in the build at boot
